review.method: Visual review with local Whisper transcript support

steps.title: Draw the first circle
steps.instruction: Use the circle tool with Control and Shift to draw a centered circle.

steps.title: Offset the duplicate
steps.instruction: Duplicate the circle, reduce its size, and move it upward.

steps.title: Make a crescent
steps.instruction: Select both circles and apply the Difference path operation.

steps.title: Build three arms
steps.instruction: Move the rotation center, duplicate the crescent, and make two 120-degree rotations.

steps.title: Add the center circle
steps.instruction: Draw a small centered circle in the middle of the three arms.

steps.title: Unite the arms
steps.instruction: Select the three arms and apply the Union path operation.

steps.title: Create the outer ring
steps.instruction: Duplicate the center circle twice and subtract the smaller circle from the larger circle.

steps.title: Remove the center
steps.instruction: Subtract the center circle from the united arm shape.

steps.title: Cut the ring gap
steps.instruction: Use an outset duplicate to cut a matching gap between the arms and ring.

steps.title: Finish the symbol
steps.instruction: Unite the ring and arms, then set the final color.
